notes: Avature portal. Rendered SearchJobs page has one GET/POST form action=https://careers.tsmc.com/en_US/careers/SearchJobs with method=post and fields: search (keyword), 4177 Organization, 1277 Location, 4178 dependent location, 558 Job Category, 147 Job Type, 542 Employment Type, hidden jobSort/jobSortDirection/listFilterMode. Paging uses jobRecordsPerPage and jobOffset and sorting uses the data-sortby=postedDate (Latest Update) and jobname (Title A-Z) controls. Cloudflare returns 403 to plain curl; a headless browser rendered the page and these controls. The adapter requests the unfiltered, title-sorted listing and applies filters locally.
